prompt:

19th-century vintage cookbook engraving, fine cross-hatching and stippling linework, faded ink, umber ink with madder red and sage accents, isolated single subject, transparent background, flat lighting, no shadows, no text.
Subject: Stoppered apothecary jar with completely blank cartouche label. Three-quarter view unless diagonal utensils.

Recolour to dominant umber #2e2119 and #5a3e2e, faded madder #a24f3f and muted sage #6f7c5a as restrained accents. No other hue. Airy unprinted areas and highlights transparent. Center complete subject with generous clear margins. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, modern flat vector shapes, smooth gradients, drop shadow, ground plane, background paper, checkerboard pattern or extra subjects.
